## Defect attribution — explicit UNATTRIBUTABLE (no rebar ticket id exists)

Both candidate origins predate the `rebar-ticket:` trailer convention **and the tracker
itself**, so no ticket id can be recorded. Recording the searches instead, per protocol.

### Searches run (all path-scoped and bounded)

| Question | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Origin of the `!= "open"` guard | `git log -L` on the guard lines; `git log --diff-filter=A -- '*ticket_txn*'` | `c5d79b58b6` (Jun 8 2026 20:37) |
| Bash-era predecessor? | `git log -S'not "open"' -- '*.sh'`; `git grep -i claim b534f47a7f -- '*.sh'` | **none — no `claim` verb existed in the bash era** |
| Relocation carrier? | `git show e6e645ae85 --stat` | confirmed carrier: +390 into `_commands/txn.py`, -380 from `_engine/ticket_txn.py`. Walked through it. |
| When `blocked` became agent-independent | `git log -S'"Blocked": "blocked"' -- src/` | `b534f47a7f` (Jun 8 2026 12:23) — inherited in the DSO seed import |
| Who legitimised the blocked resume | `git log -S'a \`blocked\` resume' -- src/rebar/_commands/` | exactly one: `95577d1960` (Jun 26 2026 18:35) |
| Ticket that scoped the `claim` verb | `git log --follow -- src/rebar/_commands/claim.py`; `git log --grep=claim -- src/rebar/_commands/`; tracker-wide CREATE-title scan for "claim" | **no ticket** — only this bug's own two spin-offs |
| Trailer recovery on every candidate | `git show -s <sha>` x8 | **absent on all 7 candidates**; convention starts ~Jul 2 2026 |

### The two candidate origins

1. **`95577d1960`** (Jun 26 2026) — *"feat(gates): enforce plan-review gate on transition
   open→in_progress; consolidate claim/transition gate (#49)"*. **The stronger origin, classed
   as an UNMET OBLIGATION.** It created the contract — keying the start-work gate on the target
   so it covers "a `blocked` resume", stating its goal as consolidating claim and transition
   *"so the two start-work paths can't diverge"* — and then did not meet it: it edited
   `claim.py` in the same commit (lifting `_plan_review_precheck` into shared `gates`) but never
   touched `txn.py`, leaving the newly-sanctioned edge with no non-racy verb. `(#49)` is a
   subject-embedded number, not a rebar id; no numeric-id ticket directories exist.
2. **`c5d79b58b6`** (Jun 8 2026) — introduced the `claim` verb with the guard already verbatim
   as it ships today. Spec authority was a design doc, **not a ticket**:
   `REMEDIATION_PROPOSAL.md` §WS5c (*"re-read status (must be `open`) ... reject with exit 10 if
   not `open`"*), deleted by `eecce19e51`.

### The date test

The implicated lines date to Jun 8 2026; `blocked` was first described as a resumable
start-work state on Jun 26 2026. The lines **predate** the point the behaviour became wrong,
which is exactly the signal that the fix site is not the cause site. Notably the inbound Jira
`Blocked` -> `blocked` mapping landed Jun 8 **12:23** — about eight hours *before* `claim` was
written open-only at **20:37** — so the reconciler could already park a ticket in `blocked` on
the day the open-only rule was specced.

### Divergence from the default

A whole-file `git blame` majority would name `e6e645ae85` (the E5c relocation). That is a
**carrier**, not an origin, and it is recorded here as rejected. Since neither surviving
candidate maps to a ticket id, **`--caused-by` is deliberately left unset on the close** rather
than fabricating one — a wrong culprit is worse for the escape-rate metric than a blank.
